## Scenario routing
- Work visa filing or renewal: start with the work-visas cluster, then the work-visas service page.
- Citizenship, residency, or Ministry of Interior process: start with the citizenship-status cluster, then the citizenship service page.
- Tourist visa, invitation letter, ETA, or entry permit question: start with the tourist-entry cluster, then tourist-visas or entry-permits.
- Delay, questioning, refusal of entry, or detention at Ben Gurion: start with the ben-gurion-emergency cluster and emergency service page.
- Terminology or legal labels: use the glossary before citing a service or article.
